I Became an Apartment Manager (Official)
“Sleep with the women living in this building—whether through blackmail, seduction, or even force.”
Hans Lee accepts the sweet but dangerous offer that could turn his miserable life upside down…
“Apartment 301, the married woman Suzy Han. I need to find this woman’s weakness fast!”
